resources.string: Lets you freeze the current screen, tap elements to inspect their accessibility attributes, and save the result for later review.

1. Enable the service below.
2. A small bubble appears on top of every screen — drag it anywhere.
3. Tap the bubble to freeze the current screen.
4. Tap any element on the frozen screenshot to inspect it; tapping again picks the topmost element under your finger if several overlap.
5. Tap Save to store the screenshot, the full accessibility tree, and every element you selected. Find it later in the Captured tab.
